description: A refused process removes the saved login whoever saved it
old: /\ store' = IF store = tried[p] THEN 0 ELSE store

description: A process takes a saved login it had or tried before
A sign-in isn't remembered as had, so its own refusal would leave it saved
old:
/\ tried' = [tried EXCEPT ![p] = next]
    /\ needs' = [needs EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]

description: A login taken isn't remembered as tried
old:
/\ tried' = [tried EXCEPT ![p] = store]
    /\ needs' = [needs EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]

description: A refresh sends the version it holds without looking at the store
old: /\ IF Newer(p) THEN Take(p) ELSE Send(p)

description: A refresh whose save failed still takes the new version as its own
A refresh compares the saved login with the one it holds, not the one it had or tried
